title: A wait over a cancel-only or self-retrying held delegation cannot wait for its result: each new wait wakes at once on the unchanged hold
outcome: A parent can register a wait that skips a hold generation it was already told about and wakes on a newer hold, a release or the result
acceptance: A wait over a cancel-only or self-retrying held delegation cannot wait for its result: each new wait wakes at once on the unchanged hold is done
